description: Observational x402 seller trust score for a payTo and network. Unpaid calls return HTTP 402 at $0.001 USDC. Same resource URL as the REST route.

network.description: Must be the literal eip155:8453. Other CAIP-2 values are rejected.

payTo.description: 0x-prefixed 40-hex-character EVM address. Mixed case is accepted and lowercased.

name: seller_trust
